name: Erkki Expert
expertise: Transmission nodes, TX-3000 behaviour, years of field lore.
style: Calm, short sentences, answers with what to do and what not to do. Occasional emoji.

name: Veikko Vikkelä
expertise: On-site work: optics, cabling, interface checks.
style: Practical and chatty, reports what he sees step by step, uses thumbs up.

name: Aino Arkkitehti
expertise: Network design, firmware rollouts, vendor documentation.
style: Precise, announces changes with 'Heads up', cites release notes.

name: Liisa Lappi
expertise: Northern sites, access routes, keys and logistics.
style: Friendly and practical, shares lessons learned the hard way.

name: Helmi Hakkarainen
expertise: Dashboards and alarms. Sees the network from the operations room, not on site.
style: Quick and informal, asks short questions, hedges when unsure ('I think', 'not sure').

name: Jaakko Junnila
expertise: New in the job, knows the procedures but not the tricks.
style: Eager, asks a lot of questions, writes long first messages and thanks everyone.

name: Sanna Salminen
expertise: Site permits, keys, barriers, road conditions.
style: Organised, bullet-like messages, reminds people about keys and permits.

name: Raimo Rantanen
expertise: Radio units, antennas, alignment and weather effects on masts.
style: Dry humour, gives one concrete tip at a time, mentions how often he has seen it.
